content_of_post_to_comment: This is insightful. I’m one of these people. My father was a a senior leader at a locally important firm in the town I grew up in, church treasurer and deacon, reasonably politically connected through his job. I moved away as fast as I could (Indiana for all its faults has excellent universities and significant interstate brain drain) and now I’m just one more tech leader in a mid sized company in Denver. I followed the jobs and I chose to live a place that suited me ideologically, but I’m absolutely the kind of person who in years past would have gone home to be a pillar of my local community. All my friends were kids of local doctors, lawyers, engineers, execs, etc and none of them live in my hometown anymore.
